messages:
pagerbot: PAGER INC-2026-1988 — 5xx spike observed on inference gateway (eu-west-1). Alert threshold breached 04:12 UTC. Current 5xx ~28%.
sam (infra-oncall): I'm picking this up. Gateway traces show a lot of retries and cross-region routing.
olivia (eng-runtime): seeing a repeated error in runtime logs: "variant_incompatible: chat cannot handle embed request". Alias 'customer-47-prod' recently got updated by a release job to 'chat-1.3' while production workloads are embed calls.
mike (sre): that explains 500s. Also seeing routing loop: eu-west->us-west fallback, then us-west retries back to eu-west because alias still resolves to eu on some nodes. Retry amplification.
anya (product): customer impact: Customer-47 runs hourly embedding jobs for search; jobs are failing and they reported errors to CS. Luis, FYI.
luis (customer-success): I've opened a bridge with the customer and gave a 15m ETA. They're seeing index/update failures. Keeping them updated every 10m.
sam (infra-oncall): Mitigation plan (short): 1) stop cross-region fallback for the alias 2) rollback alias to the last embed variant 3) add temporary policy to prevent interface-incompatible fallbacks. We can do 2 then 1.
olivia (eng-runtime): rolling rollback now. Command:
```
redwood aliases update --alias customer-47-prod --model redwood-embed-v2 --version 2026-02-embed-1
```
deploy-bot: Triggered alias update job 98765. Propagation target: eu-west-1 primary nodes.
olivia (eng-runtime): alias update applied, invalidated local alias cache on routing nodes, propagation in progress (expected ~30s-2m).
mike (sre): disabling cross-region fallback for alias to break the loop:
```
redwood routing set-policy --alias customer-47-prod --allow-cross-region-fallback false
```
Command run — policy applied.
sam (infra-oncall): monitoring metrics — gateway 5xx for customer-47 traffic dropping from 28% -> 6% in eu-west within 90s. Still seeing some stale requests hitting chat variant on older runtime workers.
olivia (eng-runtime): flushing runtime route cache on remaining nodes: `for node in $(list-nodes eu-west1); do ssh $node sudo /bin/rw-route-cache flush; done` — complete.
mike (sre): logs now show decreased "variant_incompatible" errors and an increase in successful embed responses. 5xx back to normal baseline ~1.2% for unrelated traffic.
luis (customer-success): Customer confirms some jobs succeeded after retrying; they asked for root cause summary and ETA for a permanent fix.
anya (product): follow-ups: audit release job that mistakenly set alias to chat variant, add CI gate to block interface-mismatched alias updates, and create a rollback playbook. Owner: olivia + mike.
sam (infra-oncall): Assigning postmortem: olivia (owner), mike (sre), anya (customer impact), luis (customer comms). Will gather timeline and RCA.
olivia (eng-runtime): quick note: the release pipeline had a mapping bug where a newly onboarded chat variant name collided with alias pattern `*-prod` wildcard. Fix in flight.
sam (infra-oncall): Action items added to backlog: 1) validate alias->variant interface compatibility in router (block on mismatch) 2) make allow-cross-region-fallback default false for aliases that declare an interface (embed/chat/llm) 3) postmortem + customer-facing summary.
luis (customer-success): customer asked for notification when postmortem is ready. I'll own notification.
sam (infra-oncall): Closing mitigation — system normal for customer-47. Leaving thread open for 1 hour for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: alias update job 98765 completed successfully.
pagerbot: INCIDENT INC-2026-1988 resolved by mitigation actions (alias rollback + fallback policy) — monitoring continues.
